critical_code_review_comments: _stock_total_for and the lookup aggregation correctly sum IN-OUT across all locations (no per-location filter) — matches spec.

_validate_issue_qty_against_stock aggregates same (part_no, make) qtys across multiple rows in payload before comparing to live stock — prevents users splitting a single (part,make) into two rows to bypass the cap. Good.

Frontend's overStock check is computed per row (not aggregated across rows for same part+make). If user adds two rows for 3911560/CSP with qty=20 each (total 40 > avail 26), neither row turns red individually but the backend will reject. Recommend mirroring the backend's aggregation in client check + 'Avail hint' to surface the breach earlier — minor UX gap, not a correctness bug.

Console warning 'Select is changing from uncontrolled to controlled' fires when make is reset (part_no edited) — caused by passing `value={it.make || undefined}` then later setting it to ''. Recommend always passing `value={it.make ?? ''}` consistently or use defaultValue. Cosmetic React warning only, no user-visible impact.
Lookup uses GET /api/issue-notes/lookup/{part_no} which is invoked on input blur — fine; consider debounced onChange in future for live reactivity, but blur is acceptable for v1.
